summary: Focused review found no customer-data access bypass in the examined rules and passing tests. Strong private-read and workflow validation boundaries remain in place; broad public launch still needs abuse controls and recovery planning. This score is not a certification.

findings.check: Resource exhaustion and public create access
findings.issue: Unrestricted numbers of schema-valid anonymous application/queue batches can consume Spark and mail quotas; App Check and per-client rate limiting are not enforced.
findings.recommendation: Add tested abuse controls before broad promotion, monitor usage, and keep billing disabled. App Check alone is not a complete rate limiter. Obtain approval before any paid architecture change.

findings.issue: Deletion protection and browser delete denial do not provide a full recovery backup or prevent privileged project owners from altering data.
findings.recommendation: Define a private backup/recovery and retention process; CSV is only a review copy. Seek approval for paid backup/export services.

findings.issue: Workflow updates retain only last-editor metadata, not append-only status/note history; concurrent edits can replace the same field.
findings.recommendation: Add protected append-only history and conflict handling if the operational workflow requires detailed traceability.

findings.issue: The authorized Google account is a single administrator; account recovery/MFA were not verified. The project-limited worker uses a long-lived login held in private Apps Script properties.
findings.recommendation: Protect owner accounts, restrict script collaborators, and document scoped worker rotation/revocation without sharing its credentials.

findings.issue: Allowed character and length checks do not require a minimum count of digits, so crafted submissions can contain unusable phone strings.
findings.recommendation: Add aligned client/rules normalization and digit-count tests, including Arabic/Persian numeral input, in a reviewed follow-up.

findings.issue: The dashboard listens to the full collection and reply drafts can be saved per keystroke.
findings.recommendation: Introduce pagination, server-side filtering and debounced draft writes before high-volume use.
